capabilities: Mirror Instagram DMs as one note per message
Create per-sender profile notes with editable notes and tags
Move conversations between funnel stages from folders, context menu or frontmatter
Detect trigger codes in outgoing Instagram replies to change stages
Arrange contacts as cards on a Canvas board and colour the graph view by stage
disambiguation: Not a chat client; replies are sent from Instagram (optionally via trigger codes), while Obsidian only mirrors, files and stages the conversations.
extras: The hosted companion server is free to use at present; no self-hosting instructions are given. Message text is queued on the server only until the vault acknowledges it, and the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: As a desktop app, Obsidian cannot receive Instagram message webhooks, so DM conversations stay inside Instagram instead of becoming searchable, stageable notes in the vault.

relations.evidence: Mirrors Instagram direct messages into an Obsidian vault.

requires.name: API key issued by the server

summary: Mirrors Instagram Business direct messages into vault notes, with funnel stages, per-sender profile notes, and a Canvas contact board.
